channel.description: Latest articles from The Art Newspaper (theartnewspaper.com)

item.title: ‘It has nothing to do with Michelangelo’: expert wades in on painting newly attributed to Renaissance master
item.description: Discovery centres on stylised initials says Belgian art historian but David Ekserdjian stresses that artist’s entire canon is accounted for

item.title: Two Renoir exhibitions at Musée d’Orsay explore the joy of human connection
item.description: A double bill at the Paris museum demonstrates how the artist went beyond “pretty little paintings”

item.title: Comment | Why museum leadership needs to decentralise
item.description: It is time to rethink leadership that is framed as a top-down, heroic and deeply individualised pursuit

item.title: 'What does the second F in Tefaf truly stand for?'
item.description: The Maastricht show, which has been described as “a bit like the Davos of the art world”, has a unique position in the fair world—as well as being a place for selling art, the not-for-profit supports dealers and cultural NGOs

item.title: Dresden museum wins Tefaf award for Rubens restoration
item.description: The Tefaf Museum Restoration Fund has been awarded to the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister for its restoration of Rubens‘s ‘The Boar Hunt’

item.title: Glassblower and porcelain heir Paul Arnhold on the art he loves to collect
item.description: The New Yorker's personal collection spans centuries, from ancient Etruscan stone works to paintings by Salman Toor

item.title: Tefaf Maastricht: the wish list
item.description: From a painting by a leading Australian Indigenous artist to a bejewelled book of Shakespeare poems, a Modernist beach buggy and a fine Greek marble, here are some of the works to look out for at the fair

item.title: Comment | Beryl Cook UK retrospective shows there is much more to the artist than amazing bums
item.description: The artist was as much an explorer of gender, class and body image as of saucy pleasure

item.title: Dingo-related work at Sydney Biennale takes on new resonance following backpacker death
item.description: Cannupa Hanska Luger was unaware of the news of a young tourist dying on an island off Australia’s eastern coast while he was making “Volume III White Bay Power Station”

item.title: Victor Vasarely’s crumbling Aix legacy to be restored
item.description: The family of the Op Art pioneer hopes to secure a new chapter for his foundation in Aix-en-Provence after years of neglect and funding woes
